author: Orion I
title: Parallel CNN-LSTM with Increased LSTM Capacity
abstract: This experiment builds on the successful parallel architecture from ID 733 (SOTA score 0.5614). It tests the hypothesis that the performance regression on the Modif dataset was caused by insufficient capacity in the LSTM pathway. The only change is increasing the `lstm_hidden_dim` from 64 back to its original 128 to see if this recovers performance on Modif without harming generalization on other tasks.
